people.name: Berea
people.line: City in Macedonia where Paul preached; home of Sopater.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

people.name: Silas
people.line: Prominent member of the Jerusalem church, companion of Paul.

translations.web: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
translations.bsb: As soon as night had fallen, the brothers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
translations.kjv: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
translations.asv: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Beroea: who when they were come thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
